items.name: Spear

items.name: War Pick

items.name: Warhammer

items.name: Whip

items.name: Blowgun
items.description: Silent, nearly harmless on its own, and the perfect delivery system for poison.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Small enough to conceal under a cloak.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow

items.name: Longbow

items.name: Holy Avenger

items.name: Plate Armor

items.description: Plate protection for the shins and knees.

items.name: Tinker's Tools
items.description: Drivers, tweezers, tiny files and spare screws for clockwork and small mechanisms.

items.name: Smith's Tools
items.description: Hammers, tongs and punches for metal fittings, rivets and ammunition casings.

items.name: Woodcarver's Tools
items.description: Knives, gouges and a small saw for stocks, housings and frames.

items.name: Tinkerer's Portable Forge
items.description: A suitcase forge with a pressure boiler. Burns fuel to fill Steam-pressure charges (level 1).

items.name: Valebrick Portable Field Workshop
items.description: Toren's 32-36 kg backpack workshop: tool panels, a compact hardened-steel anvil, a small forge chamber, sealed blueprint tubes and the Valebrick Resonance Core - a refined crystal in a brass stabilisation cage. Deploys into a workbench in 30-60 seconds. Its furnace burns any fuel to fill Steam-pressure (L1) and Thermal (L2) charges; upgrades will unlock Shock charges and beyond.

items.name: Firewood Bundle
items.description: Dry split logs. Cheap and everywhere, but burns fast: 2 furnace units.

items.name: Charcoal Sack
items.description: Clean, hot-burning charcoal: 3 furnace units.

items.name: Coal Lump
items.description: Dense black coal from the mines: 4 furnace units.

items.name: Flask of Lamp Oil
items.description: Refined oil; the most efficient common fuel: 5 furnace units.

items.name: Brass Scrap
items.description: Offcuts, old fittings and casings - the basis of most housings.

items.name: Steel Bar Stock
items.description: Short bars of good steel for bolts, rams and frames.

items.name: Copper Wire Coil
items.description: Conductive wire for triggers, coils and shock circuits.

items.name: Clockwork Springs
items.description: A tin of springs, cogs and escapements.

items.name: Glass Lens
items.description: A ground lens or vial - focuses light or holds a reagent.

items.name: Leather Straps
items.description: Buckles and straps to mount a device on a body or a pack.

items.name: Alchemical Salts
items.description: Reactive salts: smoke, foam and flash compounds.

items.name: Black Powder
items.description: A small horn of powder. Keep it away from the furnace.

items.name: Valebrick Bolt Repeater
items.description: Single-barrel stationary turret carried in Toren's workshop pack (Artillerist Eldritch Cannon - Force Ballista). Deploy with an action on a small tripod within 5 ft; fire it with a bonus action: ranged attack, 30 m, 2d6 force and the target is pushed 5 ft. AC 8, HP 12; Mending restores 1d6. Basic rivet shots are free; special ammunition (Scalding or Concussion bolts) adds its own shot.

items.name: Smoke Canister
items.description: Pull the pin and throw: a 15 ft radius cloud of thick smoke heavily obscures the area for up to 1 minute unless a strong wind disperses it. Consumed on use.

items.name: Tripwire Alarm
items.description: Covers a doorway or a narrow path. When the wire is crossed it rings a loud bell or gives a bright flash. Noticing the concealed wire takes an Investigation check DC 15. Needs no charge.

items.name: Steam Grapnel Launcher
items.description: Reusable wrist launcher. Fires an anchor about 60 ft to climb, cross gaps, anchor a line or pull a light object to you. Each shot vents one Steam-pressure charge.

items.name: Sticky Foam Flask
items.description: Thrown: the foam turns a 5 ft square into difficult terrain. A creature hit directly makes a DEX save DC 15 or is restrained until it uses an action to escape. Consumed on use.

items.name: Clockwork Messenger Beetle
items.description: A palm-sized brass beetle in the style of Argus the owl, powered by its own tiny resonance cell. It carries a short note or a tiny object and follows a simple beacon or destination routine, then waits there.

items.name: Scalding Bolt
items.description: Bolt ammunition with a heat-jacketed core. On hit: normal bolt damage + 1d4 fire. One bolt per shot.

items.name: Flash Bomb
items.description: Thrown device. 10 ft radius burst of light: CON save DC 15 or blinded until the start of the creature's next turn. Consumed on use.

items.name: Shock Dart
items.description: A finned dart with a charged copper coil. 1d4 piercing + 1d4 lightning; on a failed CON save DC 15 the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Consumed on use.

items.name: Steam-Jet Gauntlet
items.description: Reusable brass gauntlet. Once per short rest, vent a Steam-pressure charge at a creature within 5 ft: STR save DC 15 or it is pushed 10 ft.

items.name: Thermal Grenade
items.description: A ceramic shell that releases a Thermal capsule's heat all at once. 10 ft radius, DEX save DC 15: 2d6 fire on a failure, half on a success. Consumed on use.

items.name: Pressure Ram
items.description: Portable breaching tool: a telescopic piston driven by a Steam-pressure charge. Advantage on checks to force doors and gates; can deal 3d6 force to an object or a creature in front of it.

items.name: Concussion Bolt
items.description: Bolt ammunition with a reinforced tip and a Force capsule core. On hit: normal bolt damage + 1d4 force, and the target makes a STR save DC 15 or is pushed 5 ft. One bolt per shot.

items.name: Blueprint: Smoke Canister
items.description: Smoke Compound + Steam Pressure Capsule + Vented Shell + Timed Valve. Parts cost 10 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Tripwire Alarm
items.description: Fine Wire + Spring Trigger + Bell or Flash Capsule + Clamp Set. Parts cost 8 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Steam Grapnel Launcher
items.description: Grapnel Head + Cable Drum + Steam Pressure Capsule + Launch Tube + Brake Gear. Advanced prototype; parts cost 40 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Sticky Foam Flask
items.description: Expansion Binder + Filament Compound + Breakable Flask + Activator Capsule. Parts cost 15 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Clockwork Messenger Beetle
items.description: Clockwork Frame + Tiny Resonance Cell + Gear Set + Lens + Message Tube. Parts cost 25 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Scalding Bolts
items.description: 3 Heavy Bolts + Thermal Capsule + Heat Jacket + Ceramic Seal = 3 Scalding Bolts. Parts cost 18 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Flash Bomb
items.description: Flash Compound Capsule + Brass Shell + Resonance Igniter + Timed Trigger. Parts cost 20 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Shock Darts
items.description: 3 Metal Darts + Shock Capsule + Copper Coil + Ceramic Insulator = 3 Shock Darts. Parts cost 18 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Steam-Jet Gauntlet
items.description: Steam Pressure Capsule + Reinforced Glove + Directional Nozzle + Heat Shield + Valve. Advanced prototype; parts cost 45 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Thermal Grenade
items.description: Thermal Capsule + Ceramic Shell + Heat Vents + Impact Trigger. Parts cost 25 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Pressure Ram
items.description: Steam Pressure Capsule + Telescopic Piston + Steel Head + Release Valve. Parts cost 30 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Concussion Bolts
items.description: 3 Heavy Bolts + Force Capsule + Reinforced Tips + Stabilizer Rings = 3 Concussion Bolts. Parts cost 15 gp.

items.name: Valebrick Folding Bracer
items.description: A metal bracer covering the whole left forearm. With a flick it unfolds into a round light shield, 25 cm in radius. Stops arrows, bolts and light blades, but it is too light to absorb blunt blows (no bonus against bludgeoning). DM item - found in the storage world.

items.name: Thermal Smoke Grenade
items.description: A reusable brass canister with a heating coil and a cartridge of smoke compound. Slot in a Thermal capsule and throw: a 10 ft radius cloud of hot smoke heavily obscures the area, and a creature entering or starting its turn inside takes 1d4 fire (once per turn). Tuned to Thermal capsules ONLY - steam cannot heat the coil and a Shock capsule would burn it out.

items.name: Blueprint: Thermal Smoke Grenade
items.description: Thermal Capsule + Smoke Compound + Vented Shell + Timed Trigger. Parts cost 25 gp. Every throw needs exactly one more Thermal capsule.

items.name: Heavy Bolt
items.description: Common part. A thick crossbow bolt blank, ready to be fitted with special tips.

items.name: Metal Dart
items.description: Common part. A balanced throwing dart with a hollow body.

items.name: Brass Shell
items.description: Common part. A hollow brass sphere that screws shut - the body of a thrown device.

items.name: Ceramic Shell
items.description: Common part. A fired-clay casing that shatters on impact and survives great heat.

items.name: Vented Shell
items.description: Common part. A perforated tin can that lets smoke out evenly.

items.name: Breakable Flask
items.description: Common part. Thin glass that bursts on impact.

items.name: Clamp Set
items.description: Common part. Small screw clamps to fix a device to a frame, post or wall.

items.name: Fine Wire
items.description: Common part. A spool of thin, nearly invisible steel wire.

items.name: Alarm Bell
items.description: Common part. A loud brass bell (or a pinch of flash powder in a cap) for alarms.

items.name: Copper Coil
items.description: Common part. Tightly wound copper that carries and stores a spark.

items.name: Copper Conductor
items.description: Common part. A copper rod that carries resonance or current.

items.name: Brass Conductor
items.description: Common part. A heavy brass bar that carries strong force without warping.

items.name: Ceramic Insulator
items.description: Common part. Fired ceramic that blocks heat and current - keeps the user safe.

items.name: Ceramic Seal
items.description: Common part. A ceramic plug that holds heat inside a bolt until impact.

items.name: Ceramic Sleeve
items.description: Common part. A ceramic tube that holds a heat crystal.

items.name: Heat Seal
items.description: Common part. A gasket that keeps steam from leaking at the joins.

items.name: Heat Shield
items.description: Common part. A plate that protects the hand from venting steam.

items.name: Reinforced Glove
items.description: Common part. A heavy leather glove with steel plates over the knuckles.

items.name: Steel Head
items.description: Common part. A solid steel ram face.

items.name: Reinforced Housing
items.description: Common part. A thick steel casing for a violent burst of force.

items.name: Gear Set
items.description: Common part. Tiny brass gears and pinions for clockwork.

items.name: Message Tube
items.description: Common part. A tiny watertight tube for a rolled note.

items.name: Reinforced Pressure Chamber
items.description: Specialized part. A thick-walled brass cylinder that holds steam under pressure.

items.name: Treated Steam Medium
items.description: Specialized part. Mineral-treated water that holds pressure longer than plain water.

items.name: Spring Valve
items.description: Specialized part. A self-closing valve that releases pressure on demand.

items.name: Release Valve
items.description: Specialized part. A quick-dump valve that releases all the pressure at once.

items.name: Timed Valve
items.description: Specialized part. A valve on a clockwork delay of a few seconds.

items.name: Timed Trigger
items.description: Specialized part. A clockwork fuse that fires a device a few seconds after arming.

items.name: Impact Trigger
items.description: Specialized part. A striker that fires the device the moment it hits something.

items.name: Spring Trigger
items.description: Specialized part. A spring catch that snaps when the tripwire is pulled.

items.name: Heat Vents
items.description: Specialized part. Fins that direct a heat burst outward.

items.name: Vent Regulator
items.description: Specialized part. Controls how fast a heat cell lets its heat out.

items.name: Heat Conductor
items.description: Specialized part. A copper-silver rod that carries heat from the crystal to the device.

items.name: Heat Jacket
items.description: Specialized part. A sleeve that keeps a bolt's core scalding until impact.

items.name: Telescopic Piston
items.description: Specialized part. A nested piston that shoots out with great force.

items.name: Stabilizer Rings
items.description: Specialized part. Rings that keep a heavy-tipped bolt flying straight.

items.name: Reinforced Tips
items.description: Specialized part. Blunt steel caps that deliver force instead of piercing.

items.name: Compression Ring
items.description: Specialized part. Holds a force crystal under tension until release.

items.name: Discharge Contact
items.description: Specialized part. Releases stored current when it touches a target.

items.name: Directional Nozzle
items.description: Specialized part. Aims a jet of steam in one direction.

items.name: Cable Drum
items.description: Specialized part. A spring-loaded drum with 60 ft of thin steel cable.

items.name: Launch Tube
items.description: Specialized part. A barrel that fires a grapnel with a burst of steam.

items.name: Brake Gear
items.description: Specialized part. Stops the cable drum smoothly so the line does not snap.

items.name: Grapnel Head
items.description: Specialized part. Folding steel hooks that open on impact.

items.name: Clockwork Frame
items.description: Specialized part. A beetle-shaped brass chassis with folding wings.

items.name: Resonance Igniter
items.description: Specialized part. A crystal sliver that sparks when struck.

items.name: Smoke Compound
items.description: Specialized part. Treated salts that turn into thick smoke when heated or pressurised.

items.name: Filament Compound
items.description: Specialized part. Fibres that turn into sticky strands when mixed with the binder.

items.name: Expansion Binder
items.description: Specialized part. A resin that swells a hundred times over in seconds.

items.name: Flash Compound Capsule
items.description: Specialized part. Magnesium salts sealed in a capsule - a blinding flash on ignition.

items.name: Activator Capsule
items.description: Specialized part. A small capsule that mixes and pressurises foam when broken.

items.name: Brass Stabilizer Cage
items.description: Specialized part. A small caged frame that keeps a crystal from vibrating apart.

items.name: Tiny Resonance Cell
items.description: Rare part (DM reward). A crystal chip that powers small clockwork for days.

items.name: Cut Resonance Crystal
items.description: Rare part (DM reward). A precisely cut arcane-reactive crystal.

items.name: Thermic Crystal
items.description: Rare part (DM reward). A red crystal that gives off steady heat when struck.

items.name: Charged Crystal
items.description: Rare part (DM reward). A crystal that crackles with a stored spark.

items.name: Dense Resonance Crystal
items.description: Rare part (DM reward). A heavy, dark resonance crystal that releases force.

items.name: Blueprint: Steam Pressure Capsule
items.description: Fills one spent Steam-pressure (level 1) charge without the furnace: controlled mechanical pressure for launchers, rams, grapnels and steam tools. Parts cost 8 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Thermal Capsule
items.description: Fills one spent Thermal (level 2) charge: controlled heat for thermal ammunition, cutting, welding and fire devices. Parts cost 12 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Shock Capsule
items.description: Fills one spent Shock (level 3) charge: an electrical discharge for shock darts, alarms, traps and electrical tools. Parts cost 12 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Force Capsule
items.description: Fills one spent Force (level 4) charge: a controlled kinetic burst for concussion ammunition, breaching tools and force projectors. Parts cost 15 gp.

items.name: Blueprint: Arcane Resonance Capsule
items.description: Fills one spent Arcane Resonance (level 5) charge: a general-purpose energy cell for projectors, force devices and repair tools. Parts cost 10 gp.
